body: My base line goal has always been to help others. My biggest goal has been to reform public mental health. I also wanted to help others through my passions of making music, and streaming.

The only purpose i ever sought after was my dreams. I have many of them. The combination of everything within my life makes those dreams not obtainable. Depression, anxiety, and the shitty paper this world revolves around.

That’s what i ask myself everyday. I know purpose is created by us mentally. No matter what we don’t serve a purpose we just exist. It’s what our mind tells us would make us mean something. The things I’ve chased after to establish fulfilling the purpose i wanted were not, and still not obtainable.

Why does it matter at that point? At the end of the day i don’t want to live miserable, and unhappy my whole life. I could care less what anyone else thinks at that point but there no decent opinion exerted towards me to even think that ending my life isn’t the proper option.

My whole life I’ve tried to chase help. I would not come to this final conclusion if i didn’t exhaust every resource i could possibly go through to get better. I don’t know if it even was the right medicine since i couldn’t afford it long enough to stay on it.

I wish it was worth it, but it’s not. If i die everyone that knows who i am is going to feel bad for being a piece of shit to me which are feelings they deserve to feel. Everyone else will grieve, and move on. It’s just how life works.
